title_zh: 放弃吵闹演出并约好周日听安静的音乐

scenario.label_zh: 按音乐喜好更换相约听演出的日期
scenario.goal_zh: 说明对朋克演出音量的顾虑，改约周日听较安静的原声演出

context_zh: 朋友比较同一家小场地周末的演出。
author: author-phase08-c

sentences.speaker: Callum
sentences.text: Do you fancy the punk gig on Friday? My cousin's band is playing.

sentences.speaker: Zoe
sentences.text: I listen to punk occasionally, but I'm not in the mood for a loud evening.

sentences.speaker: Callum
sentences.text: That's a pity. I was hoping we could go together.

sentences.speaker: Zoe
sentences.text: Is there anything quieter another night? I'd still like to spend some time with you.

sentences.speaker: Callum
sentences.text: There's an acoustic duo on Sunday. I've heard them, and the room stays fairly relaxed.

sentences.speaker: Zoe
sentences.text: Sunday sounds better. Shall we meet outside at seven?

sentences.speaker: Callum
sentences.text: Yes, seven on Sunday. I'll tell my cousin I'm coming to see them another time.
